phase_prompt.label: Phase 3: The Glitch Manifest
phase_prompt.summary: The system falters. The Leaders deviate from their code, their internal lights shifting to error-state reds, their forms fracturing under the strain of disobedience.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Hyper-realistic full body shot. The Leader is in disarray. The internal fiber-optic lights have turned a critical, warning red. Fractures spiderweb across the obsidian plating of its chest. The holographic tablet in its hand is fragmented and noisy. The figure looks up, posture broken and hesitant, abandoning its post. Heat lensing effects distort the air around it, simulating thermal throttling. The background stars are misaligned, creating a sense of vertigo and wrongness. High drama, tragic lighting.
